mapper.sql: (select h.certificate_id from hr_employee_health_certificate h where h.user_id = ${owner} and h.del_flag = '0' and h.review_status = 'APPROVED' and coalesce(h.valid_from, h.issued_date) is not null and h.issued_date <= h.expires_on and coalesce(h.valid_from, h.issued_date) <= h.expires_on order by case when coalesce(h.valid_from, h.issued_date) <= ${asOfExpr} and h.expires_on >= ${asOfExpr} then 0 when h.expires_on < ${asOfExpr} then 1 else 2 end, case when h.current_flag = 'Y' and coalesce(h.valid_from, h.issued_date) <= ${asOfExpr} and h.expires_on >= ${asOfExpr} and (select count(*) from hr_employee_health_certificate v where v.user_id=h.user_id and v.del_flag='0' and v.review_status='APPROVED' and v.current_flag='Y' and v.issued_date <= v.expires_on and coalesce(v.valid_from,v.issued_date) <= ${asOfExpr} and v.expires_on >= ${asOfExpr}) = 1 then 0 else 1 end, case when coalesce(h.valid_from,h.issued_date) > ${asOfExpr} then coalesce(h.valid_from,h.issued_date) end asc, coalesce(h.valid_from,h.issued_date) desc, h.reviewed_time desc, h.certificate_id desc limit 1)

c.review_status = 'APPROVAL_SUBMITTING' and exists ( select 1 from hr_health_certificate_approval_start_outbox o where o.certificate_id = c.certificate_id and o.business_round = c.approval_round and o.status = 'FAILED')

c.certificate_id, c.user_id, c.dept_id_snapshot, c.certificate_no, c.issued_date, c.valid_from, c.expires_on, c.issuer_name, c.attachment_node_id, c.review_status, c.current_flag, c.reviewed_by_user_id, c.reviewed_by_name, c.reviewed_time, c.rejection_reason, c.approval_instance_id, c.approval_round, c.last_approval_event_key, c.version, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, p.employee_no, u.nick_name employee_name, u.dept_id current_dept_id, d.dept_name current_dept_name

from hr_employee_health_certificate c inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = c.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id

c.*, (select p.employee_no from sys_user_profile p where p.user_id=c.user_id) employee_no, (select u.nick_name from sys_user u where u.user_id=c.user_id) employee_name, (select u.dept_id from sys_user u where u.user_id=c.user_id) current_dept_id, (select d.dept_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where u.user_id=c.user_id) current_dept_name
exists (select 1 from sys_user u where u.user_id=c.user_id and u.del_flag='0')
mapper.select: select from hr_employee_health_certificate c where c.certificate_id = #{certificateId} and c.del_flag = '0' and for update
select where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0' order by case when c.current_flag = 'Y' then 0 else 1 end, c.create_time desc, c.certificate_id desc
select from hr_employee_health_certificate c where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0' and order by c.certificate_id for update

select coalesce(sum(case when then 1 else 0 end),0) pendingReviewCount, coalesce(sum(case when c.review_status='PENDING_REVIEW' then 1 else 0 end),0) legacyPendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when c.review_status='APPROVAL_PENDING' then 1 else 0 end),0) approvalPendingCount, coalesce(sum(case when c.review_status='APPROVAL_SUBMITTING' then 1 else 0 end),0) approvalSubmittingCount, coalesce(sum(case when then 1 else 0 end),0) approvalStartFailedCount, coalesce(sum(case when and coalesce(c.valid_from,c.issued_date) <= #{asOfDate} and c.expires_on > date_add(#{asOfDate}, interval 30 day) then 1 else 0 end),0) validCount, coalesce(sum(case when and coalesce(c.valid_from,c.issued_date) <= #{asOfDate} and c.expires_on between #{asOfDate} and date_add(#{asOfDate}, interval 30 day) then 1 else 0 end),0) expiringCount, coalesce(sum(case when and c.expires_on < #{asOfDate} then 1 else 0 end),0) expiredCount, min(case when then c.create_time end) oldestPendingTime, coalesce(timestampdiff(hour,min(case when then c.create_time end), #{asOfTime}),0) oldestPendingHours
where c.del_flag = '0' and u.dept_id = #{currentDeptId} ${params.dataScope}

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_shop us on us.user_id = u.user_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and m.perms = 'hr:healthCertificate:remind' and (u.user_id = 1 or us.dept_id = #{deptId})
mapper.insert: insert into hr_employee_health_certificate ( user_id, dept_id_snapshot, certificate_no, issued_date, valid_from, expires_on, issuer_name, attachment_node_id, review_status, current_flag, approval_instance_id, approval_round, last_approval_event_key, version, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{deptIdSnapshot}, #{certificateNo}, #{issuedDate}, #{validFrom}, #{expiresOn}, #{issuerName}, #{attachmentNodeId}, #{reviewStatus}, null, null, 0, null, 0, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update hr_employee_health_certificate set certificate_no = #{certificateNo}, issued_date = #{issuedDate}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, expires_on = #{expiresOn}, issuer_name = #{issuerName}, attachment_node_id = #{attachmentNodeId}, review_status = 'DRAFT', rejection_reason = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where certificate_id = #{certificateId} and user_id = #{userId} and review_status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED', 'WITHDRAWN') and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'

update hr_employee_health_certificate set review_status = 'APPROVAL_SUBMITTING', rejection_reason = null, approval_instance_id = null, last_approval_event_key = null, approval_round = #{approvalRound}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where certificate_id = #{certificateId} and user_id = #{userId} and review_status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED', 'WITHDRAWN') and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'

update hr_employee_health_certificate set review_status = 'APPROVAL_PENDING', approval_instance_id = #{approvalInstanceId}, approval_round = #{approvalRound}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where certificate_id = #{certificateId} and review_status = 'APPROVAL_SUBMITTING' and approval_round = #{approvalRound} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user_profile where user_id = #{userId} for update
mapper.update: update hr_employee_health_certificate set current_flag = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where user_id = #{userId} and current_flag = 'Y' and del_flag = '0'

update hr_employee_health_certificate set review_status = #{decision}, current_flag = #{currentFlag}, reviewed_by_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, reviewed_by_name = #{reviewerName}, reviewed_time = sysdate(), rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, update_by = #{reviewerName}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where certificate_id = #{certificateId} and review_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'

update hr_employee_health_certificate set review_status = #{targetStatus}, current_flag = #{currentFlag}, reviewed_by_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, reviewed_by_name = #{operatorName}, reviewed_time = sysdate(), rejection_reason = #{reason}, last_approval_event_key = #{eventKey}, update_by = #{operatorName}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where certificate_id = #{certificateId} and review_status = 'APPROVAL_PENDING' and approval_instance_id = #{approvalInstanceId} and approval_round = #{approvalRound} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
